en: The image shows the back side of a postcard. The most prominent text reads 'Loudův Camp topp,' with 'topp' in large, bold, stylized letters. There is also a small circular logo with the number 40 and what appears to be an animal head, possibly a horse. The postcard is addressed by hand to Karel Venzara, with the address including 'Dráč Slavní H15, Hlinsko v Č.' There is a vertical word 'MANUFACTURING,' a small star and eagle logo with 'WB,' and a series of numbers '53907.' There is also a faint stamp from the National Museum (Muzeum Národní) in the lower right corner.
